name: A diplomat does not arrive

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: DeLavey says the envoy bound for a meeting with Jaina never arrived.
description: Bishop DeLavey explains the absence that the city has not yet made common knowledge: a diplomat sent to Theramore to meet Lady Jaina Proudmoore never reached his destination. The king’s agents are already searching, but the bishop will set his own contacts in motion. A sealed letter leads first to Jorgen, a fisherman in the Valley of Heroes. The story has a destination, though not yet a culprit.
